title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2024
excerpt: Our first international book fair with our own stand: four days of rights meetings and conversations in the colourful world of children’s books.
image_alt: Epsilon Publishing Group’s first stand at the Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2024
body:
The Bologna Children’s Book Fair, held on 8–11 April 2024, marked a milestone for Epsilon Publishing Group: our first international book fair with our own stand.

The colourful world of children’s books made it a welcoming and joyful place to begin this new chapter. Over four busy days, scheduled rights meetings were complemented by spontaneous conversations with publishers, illustrators, translators, agents and authors who stopped by our stand. Sharing our stories with colleagues from around the world opened doors to new rights opportunities and laid the foundations for future collaborations. Our first Bologna stand was an important step in introducing Epsilon to the international publishing community and helping our authors’ stories find their way to readers in new languages.
